{{Short description|Iranian nuclear scientist (1979–2012)}}
{{Use dmy dates|date=February 2024}}
'''Mostafa Ahmadi Roshan''' ({{langx|fa|مصطفی احمدی روشن}}; 8 September 1979 in [[Hamadan]] – 11 January 2012 in [[Tehran]])<ref name="Ali6" /><ref name="hamshahrionline" /> was an [[Iranian peoples|Iranian]] [[nuclear scientist]]<ref name="Ali2">{{cite web | url=https://www.aljazeera.com/news/middleeast/2012/01/201211162848691713.html | title=Iran nuclear scientist killed by car bomb | publisher=aljazeera.com | accessdate=1 June 2019}}</ref><ref name="Ali4" /> who was assassinated<ref name="Ali1">{{cite web | url=http://www.aviny.com/News/93/10/22/ahmadi-roshan.aspx | title=Biography of Ahmadi-Roshan | publisher=aviny.com | accessdate=1 June 2019}}</ref><ref name="Ali3" /> in 2012.<ref name="Ali2" /><ref name="Ali3">{{cite web | url=https://www.businessinsider.com/sunday-times-mossad-assassinated-iranian-scientist-2012-1 | title=Mossad Agents Assassinated The Iranian Scientist Last Week — Sunday Times | publisher=businessinsider.com | accessdate=2 June 2019}}</ref><ref name="Ali5" /> He was also deputy of commerce at the [[Natanz Nuclear Facility|Natanz nuclear power plant]].<ref>{{cite web | url=https://www.tabnak.ir/fa/news/803348/%D8%AA%D8%B1%D9%88%D8%B1-%D9%85%D8%B5%D8%B7%D9%81%DB%8C-%D8%A7%D8%AD%D9%85%D8%AF%DB%8C-%D8%B1%D9%88%D8%B4%D9%86 | title=Ahmadi Roshan assassination | publisher=tabnak.ir | accessdate=10 June 2019}}</ref>[[File:Memorial of Iranian Murdered scientists.jpg|thumb|upright|alt=Indoor memorial, with photos and an Iranian flag|Memorial to assassinated Iranian scientists]]

==Life==
Ahmadi Roshan (also known as "[[Shahid]] Ahmadi-Roshan" after the assassination, denoting his status as a martyr)<ref>{{cite web | url=https://khanemostanad.ir/?p=2700 | title=The life of Shahid Ahmadi Roshan | date=24 December 2017 | publisher=khanemostanad.ir | accessdate=11 July 2019}}</ref><ref>{{cite web | url=https://www.ilam.ac.ir/news/show/?ihwfsykkk-%D8%B2%D9%86%D8%AF%DA%AF%D9%8A%D9%86%D8%A7%D9%85%D9%87-%D8%B4%D9%87%D9%8A%D8%AF-%D9%85%D9%87%D9%86%D8%AF%D8%B3-%D8%A7%D8%AD%D9%85%D8%AF%D9%8A-%D8%B1%D9%88%D8%B4%D9%86 | title=Biography of engineer/Shahid Ahmadi Roshan | publisher=ilam.ac.ir | accessdate=11 July 2019}}</ref> was born on 8 September 1979<ref name="hamshahrionline">{{cite web | url=https://www.hamshahrionline.ir/news/245627/%D8%B2%D9%86%D8%AF%DA%AF%DB%8C%D9%86%D8%A7%D9%85%D9%87-%D9%85%D8%B5%D8%B7%D9%81%DB%8C-%D8%A7%D8%AD%D9%85%D8%AF%DB%8C-%D8%B1%D9%88%D8%B4%D9%86-%DB%B1%DB%B3%DB%B5%DB%B8-%DB%B1%DB%B3%DB%B9%DB%B0 | title=Biography of Ahmadi Roshan | date=12 January 2014 | publisher=hamshahrionline.ir | accessdate=11 July 2019}}</ref> in the village of Sangestan in [[Hamedan Province|Hamedan]] province, and grew up in a poor family.<ref name="Ali6" /> He was among the students of [[Aziz Khoshvaght]] (who was known as an [[Islamic]] moralist),<ref name="Ali6">{{cite web | url=https://hawzah.net/fa/Article/View/93185/%D8%B2%D9%86%D8%AF%DA%AF%DB%8C%D9%86%D8%A7%D9%85%D9%87-%D8%B4%D9%87%DB%8C%D8%AF-%D9%85%D8%B5%D8%B7%D9%81%DB%8C-%D8%A7%D8%AD%D9%85%D8%AF%DB%8C-%D8%B1%D9%88%D8%B4%D9%86 | title=Biography of Shahid Ahmadi-Roshan | publisher=hawzah.net | accessdate=2 June 2019}}</ref> studied [[polymer engineering]] at the [[Sharif University of Technology]], and had published several [[Institute for Scientific Information]] (ISI) articles in English and Persian<ref name="Ali5">{{cite web | url=http://www.aviny.com/News/93/10/22/ahmadi-roshan.aspx | title=Shahid Ahmadi-Roshanbiography | publisher=aviny.com | accessdate=2 June 2019}}</ref> by the time he was 32 years old.<ref name="Ali6" /><ref>{{cite web | url=https://edition.cnn.com/2012/01/11/world/meast/iran-who-kills-scientists/index.html | title=Who's killing Iranian nuclear scientists? | date=11 January 2012 | publisher=cnn.com | accessdate=10 June 2019}}</ref>
[[File:Natanz nuclear.jpg|upright|thumb|Anti-aircraft guns at Natanz Nuclear Facility (2006)]]

==Family==
Ahmadi Roshan was married to Fatemeh Boluri-Kashani,<ref>{{cite web | url=https://www.yjc.ir/fa/news/6396115/%D8%B4%D8%B4%D9%85%DB%8C%D9%86-%D8%B3%D8%A7%D9%84-%D8%AF%D8%B1-%D9%81%D8%B1%D8%A7%D9%82-%D9%85%D8%B5%D8%B7%D9%81%DB%8C | title=Mosfata Ahmadi Roshan | publisher=yjc.ir | accessdate=24 June 2019}}</ref> who graduated with a master's degree in chemistry from Sharif University. His father was Rahim Ahmadi Roshan<ref name="Ali33">{{cite web | url=https://www.mashreghnews.ir/news/820093/%D9%BE%DB%8C%D8%B1%D9%88%DB%8C-%D8%A7%D8%B2-%D9%88%D9%84%D8%A7%DB%8C%D8%AA-%D8%AE%D8%B7-%D9%82%D8%B1%D9%85%D8%B2-%D8%A2%D9%82%D8%A7-%D9%85%D8%B5%D8%B7%D9%81%DB%8C-%D8%A8%D9%88%D8%AF-%D8%B9%D9%84%D8%A7%D9%82%D9%87-%D9%81%D8%B1%D8%B2%D9%86%D8%AF-%D8%B4%D9%87%DB%8C%D8%AF-%D8%A7%D8%AD%D9%85%D8%AF%DB%8C-%D8%B1%D9%88%D8%B4%D9%86 | title=Shahid Ahmadi Roshan | date=13 January 2018 | publisher=mashreghnews.ir | accessdate=11 June 2019}}</ref> and his mother was Sedigheh Salari.<ref>{{cite web | url=http://www.dana.ir/news/1277516.html/%D8%B1%D9%88%D8%A7%DB%8C%D8%AA-%D9%85%D8%A7%D8%AF%D8%B1-%D8%B4%D9%87%DB%8C%D8%AF-%D8%A7%D8%AD%D9%85%D8%AF%DB%8C-%D8%B1%D9%88%D8%B4%D9%86-%D8%A7%D8%B2-%D8%B3-%D9%85%D8%AA-%D8%AD%D8%B3%D8%A7%D8%B3-%D9%81%D8%B1%D8%B2%D9%86%D8%AF%D8%B4-%DA%A9%D9%87-%D9%87%DB%8C%DA%86-%D8%AC%D8%A7-%D8%A7%D8%B2-%D8%A2%D9%86-%D9%86%D8%A7%D9%85-%D8%A8%D8%B1%D8%AF%D9%87-%D9%86%D8%B4%D8%AF | title=Narration from the mother of Shahid Ahmadi Roshan | publisher=dana.ir | accessdate=28 June 2019}}</ref> His only child,<ref name="Ali5555" /> Ali-Reza,<ref name="Ali33" /> was four years old when Ahmadi Roshan was killed.<ref name="Ali5555">{{cite web | url=https://www.asriran.com/fa/news/196710/%D8%B4%D9%87%D8%AF%D8%A7%DB%8C-%D8%A7%D9%86%D9%81%D8%AC%D8%A7%D8%B1-%D8%A7%D9%85%D8%B1%D9%88%D8%B2-%D8%AA%D9%87%D8%B1%D8%A7%D9%86-%D8%A8%D9%87-2-%D9%86%D9%81%D8%B1-%D8%A7%D9%81%D8%B2%D8%A7%DB%8C%D8%B4-%DB%8C%D8%A7%D9%81%D8%AA-%DA%AF%D8%B2%D8%A7%D8%B1%D8%B4-%D8%AA%D8%B5%D9%88%DB%8C%D8%B1%DB%8C-%D8%A7%D8%B2-%D9%85%D8%AD%D9%84-%D8%AD%D8%A7%D8%AF%D8%AB%D9%87 | title=Tehran explosion martyrs | publisher=asriran.com | accessdate=11 June 2019}}</ref>

== Death ==
Roshan was killed on 11 January 2012 by a motorbike bomb at 8:30am<ref name="Ali4">{{cite news | url=https://www.theguardian.com/world/2012/jan/11/iran-nuclear-scientist-killed | title=Iran nuclear scientist killed in Tehran motorbike bomb attack | newspaper=The Guardian | date=11 January 2012 | publisher=theguardian.com | accessdate=2 June 2019| last1=Dehghan | first1=Saeed Kamali }}</ref><ref>{{cite web | url=https://www.mashreghnews.ir/news/91386/%D8%AC%D8%B2%D8%A6%DB%8C%D8%A7%D8%AA-%D8%AA%D8%B1%D9%88%D8%B1-%D8%AF%D8%A7%D9%86%D8%B4%D9%85%D9%86%D8%AF-%D8%AC%D9%88%D8%A7%D9%86-%D9%87%D8%B3%D8%AA%D9%87-%D8%A7%DB%8C-%D8%AF%D8%B1-%D8%AA%D9%87%D8%B1%D8%A7%D9%86-%D8%AA%D8%B5%D8%A7%D9%88%DB%8C%D8%B1-%D9%88-%D9%81%DB%8C%D9%84%D9%85 | title=Details about the assassination of the young Iranian nuclear scientist in Tehran | date=11 January 2012 | publisher=mashreghnews.ir | accessdate=28 June 2019}}</ref> in the vicinity of [[Seyed Khandan|Seyyed Khandan]]<ref>{{cite web | url=https://www.yjc.ir/fa/news/560231/%D8%AA%D8%B1%D9%88%D8%B1-%D8%B4%D9%87%D9%8A%D8%AF-%D9%85%D8%B5%D8%B7%D9%81%D9%8A-%D8%A7%D8%AD%D9%85%D8%AF%D9%8A-%D8%B1%D9%88%D8%B4%D9%86-%D8%AD%D9%88%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%8A-%D8%B3%D9%8A%D8%AF-%D8%AE%D9%86%D8%AF%D8%A7%D9%86-%D8%B9%D9%83%D8%B3 | title=Assassination of Shahid Mostafa Ahmadi-Roshan in the vicinity of Seyyed Khandan | publisher=yjc.ir | accessdate=11 June 2019}}</ref> in [[Tehran]].<ref>{{cite news | url=https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-16501566 | title=Iran nuclear scientist killed in Tehran motorbike bomb attack | work=BBC News | date=11 January 2012 | accessdate=11 June 2019}}</ref><ref>{{cite web | url=https://www.yjc.ir/fa/news/5931977/%D8%AC%D8%B2%D8%A6%DB%8C%D8%A7%D8%AA%DB%8C-%D8%A7%D8%B2-%D9%84%D8%AD%D8%B8%D9%87-%D8%B4%D9%87%D8%A7%D8%AF%D8%AA-%D9%85%D8%B5%D8%B7%D9%81%DB%8C-%D8%A7%D8%AD%D9%85%D8%AF%DB%8C-%D8%B1%D9%88%D8%B4%D9%86-%D9%81%DB%8C%D9%84%D9%85 | title=Details from three occasions of Mostafa Ahmadi-Roshan martyrdom | publisher=yjc.ir | accessdate=11 June 2019}}</ref><ref>{{cite web | url=https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/worldnews/middleeast/iran/9006610/Iranian-nuclear-scientist-killed-in-Tehran-bomb-attack.html | title=Iranian 'nuclear scientist' killed in Tehran bomb attack | publisher=telegraph.co.uk | accessdate=11 June 2019}}</ref> He was the last of four assassinated Iranian nuclear scientists (following [[Massoud Ali-Mohammadi]], [[Majid Shahriari]], and [[Darioush Rezaeinejad]]).<ref>{{cite web | url=https://hawzah.net/fa/Occation/View/70133/%D8%B4%D9%87%D8%AF%D8%A7%DB%8C-%D8%AF%D8%A7%D9%86%D8%B4%D9%85%D9%86%D8%AF-%D9%87%D8%B3%D8%AA%D9%87-%D8%A7%DB%8C-%D8%A7%DB%8C%D8%B1%D8%A7%D9%86 | title=Iranian nuclear Shahids | publisher=hawzah.net | accessdate=22 June 2019}}</ref>

==Natanz enrichment site==
In response to this and previous assassinations, a number of students from universities throughout the country sent letters to Iranian authorities, asking them to change the names of Iranian [[Nuclear facilities in Iran|nuclear facilities]] and enrichment sites to those of the murdered scientists. Five of these requests were honored, and the [[Natanz]] enrichment site's name was changed to "The Site of Shahid Mostafa Ahmadi-Roshan".<ref>{{cite web | url=http://www.rajanews.com/news/100346 | title=Names of nuclear facilities of Iran changed to 5 Iranian assassinated nuclear scientists. | publisher=rajanews.com | accessdate=15 July 2019}}</ref>
